title: The Only Person Ever Hit by a Meteorite Was Napping

scenes.text: A meteorite crashed through a roof and hit a sleeping woman.
November thirtieth, 1954. Ann Hodges is napping on her couch in Alabama.
An eight and a half pound space rock tears through the ceiling, bounces off a radio and slams into her.
It leaves a huge bruise on her hip.
She's the first documented person to survive being struck by a meteorite.
And it's still the only one.

description:
On November 30, 1954, an 8.5 pound meteorite broke through a roof in Sylacauga, Alabama, and struck Ann Hodges while she napped.
She survived with a large bruise, and the meteorite is now in a museum.
Would you have believed it?
first_comment: Would you keep a rock that fell from the sky?
